summary: Iteration 2: RDX LUDO rebrand + Landing/Referral/Support/Profile/Wallet UI changes tested. Backend: 21 passed / 1 skipped (added new TestReferralAppliedAndRedeem class covering /api/referral applied_code+bonus_balance and /api/referral/redeem happy path and empty-bonus 400). Frontend at 420x900: 13 checks passed, 2 minor gaps (page and Hindi promo copy card). Referral gate deep-linking (/public/refer/:code and /refer/:code) stores localStorage.pending_referral and prefills login referral input; after signup /api/referral returns applied_code = referrer's code end-to-end. Header/drawer/login use RDX LUDO logo <img>. Profile Referral Applied card + Referral Redeem action wired. Wallet info banner present. Support page fully redesigned with SUPPORT CENTER pill, ONLINE pill, feature pills, CONTACT OPTIONS heading, WhatsApp INSTANT badge, and 1–2 min footer copy. /home while unauth redirects to / (landing).

Login redirects to '/' after auth; Landing has useEffect to nav('/home') when user set — works but a tiny flash of Landing is possible. Could push to '/home' directly on verify.
Referral redeem writes 2 wallet_ledger rows without a single transaction — acceptable for demo (already flagged in iteration_1).
Header bottom NavItem 'Home' points to '/' which for logged-in user re-renders Landing then redirects to /home; consider linking to /home directly to avoid the double render.
Public routes /public/refer/:code and /refer/:code both point to same ReferralGate — DRY OK.
